prerequisites: EM1012 - Mecànica de Màquines i Estructures
EM1015 - Ciència i Tecnologia de Materials
EM1019 - Elasticitat i Resistència de Materials
EM1020 - Teoria de Màquines i Mecanismes

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to analyze and improve the organizational structure of the productive system through teamwork.
Be able to analyze and improve production and manufacturing systems by applying different techniques and computer simulation tools.
Be able to explain the organization of the industrial plant.
Be able to relate production strategy with company strategy.
Know how to evaluate the adequacy between the typologies of productive processes and the organizational structure of the company.
Be able to apply planning and scheduling techniques for orders.
Be able to apply the fundamentals of quality systems and asset management.
Know how to explain the integrated processes of product and production system development.
Know how to define manufacturing processes.

syllabus_topics: The fundamental laws of process flow
Statistical analysis of the system with constant times
Stochastic modeling of a production system
Evaluation of different production system configurations
Models of production systems with failures
Concept of quality and capacity of manufacturing processes
Use of mean and dispersion charts
Model of a production system with defective products
The production planning and control process
Practice 1 - Statistics review: exponential, normal, histograms, probabilities, sum distribution, mean distribution
Practice 2 - Work 1. Performance evaluation of a production system
Practice 3 - Work 2. Model for preventive maintenance planning
Practice 4 - Work 3. Model for selecting the inventory control policy

assessment_methods.method: Written theoretical-practical knowledge tests during the course

assessment_rules: The course is passed if the overall average grade is at least 5 out of 10. The final exam requires a minimum grade of 4.5 out of 10; if this minimum is not achieved, the overall average cannot exceed 4.5 out of 10. Continuous assessment activities (laboratory practices, problem exercises, written tests) do not have a minimum grade. Continuous assessment grades are maintained for the second call within the same academic year; written tests can be recovered in the second call's final exam if the average is below 5 out of 10. For the extraordinary call at the end of studies, the final exam accounts for 100% of the grade.
